system.name: coding-agent
system.description: Claude Code or Codex CLI as a research agent (B1)

agent.name: Codex CLI
agent.how: one headless `codex exec` run in the system container

network.search: provider server-side search disabled; shared controlled search offered as MCP tools search_literature / search_web
network.web_access: WebFetch and Bash network stay on, but only through the shield proxy: URL blocklist applies, OpenAlex/S2/Tavily API calls are date-bounded, arbitrary fetched pages are not date-bounded

tools.permissions: --sandbox danger-full-access, approval_policy=never; web_search disabled; apps, plugins, browser and computer use disabled; MCP search tools

preinstalled.zh: node:22 bookworm 基础镜像；Claude Code 和 Codex CLI（固定版本）、TeX Live 子集（ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS）、python3 + uv、git、共用的受控搜索 MCP 服务
preinstalled.en: node:22 bookworm base; Claude Code and Codex CLI (pinned), a TeX Live subset (ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS), python3 + uv, git, the shared controlled-search MCP server

notes.driver: no scaffold: one headless CLI invocation; it stops when the model stops (no /goal or loop)
notes.search: provider server-side search disabled; shared controlled search offered as MCP tools search_literature / search_web
notes.web_access: WebFetch and Bash network stay on, but only through the shield proxy: URL blocklist applies, OpenAlex/S2/Tavily API calls are date-bounded, arbitrary fetched pages are not date-bounded
notes.venue: chosen by the agent from the task text; detected from LaTeX at collect time
notes.wall_clock: enforced by the runner; the entrypoint turns its SIGTERM into SIGINT so the CLI can end cleanly
notes.native_caps: none: codex exec has no budget or turn cap; only the wall-clock limit applies
notes.permissions: --sandbox danger-full-access (container and shield are the boundary)
notes.model_access: the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through codex-api 0.2.3 (account default): a Codex custom provider (Responses API) at the one host address the shield lets through
notes.key_exposure: none: the container holds only a placeholder in RWE_CODEX_API_KEY (also excluded from shell tool environments); the shield proxy puts codex-api's local key on its requests and the login stays on the host
notes.cost: Codex reports tokens only; on a ChatGPT plan there is no per-token charge, USD from a price list is notional
